title: The Unexpected Arrival
content:
The sound of the doorbell echoed through the quiet house.

A few moments later...

The front door slowly opened.

Standing outside...

Was Yashwanth.

The moment his father saw him...

His face lit up with joy.

"Yash!"

Without a second thought, he pulled his son into a warm embrace.

"My boy..."

"It's been so long."

"I've missed you so much."

Yashwanth hugged him back.

A faint smile appeared on his face.

But behind that smile...

His heart was drowning in fear.

The two of them walked inside.

His mother welcomed him with the same warmth, filling the house with happiness.

Yet...

Yashwanth couldn't enjoy any of it.

The truth he had come to reveal weighed heavily on his heart.

After a while, his father sat beside him and smiled proudly.

"It's been a long time since I last saw you, son."

"I missed you every single day."

He gently patted Yashwanth's shoulder.

"But today..."

"I'm happier than ever."

"Thank you for respecting my decision."

"I'm proud that you agreed to this marriage."

"You've made me very happy."

Every word pierced Yashwanth's heart.

He opened his mouth...

Wanting to tell the truth.

But no words came out.

His throat tightened.

His courage disappeared.

Unable to speak...

He quietly stood up and walked toward his room.

After freshening up, he sat quietly on the edge of his bed.

His thoughts refused to stop.

How do I tell him?

How do I break his heart?

Unable to decide, he took out his phone and called Siddu.

The call rang...

But no one answered.

Yashwanth slowly lowered his phone.

A wave of disappointment washed over him.

"If Siddu isn't answering..."

"There must be a genuine reason."

Even so...

He wished his friend had been beside him.

Taking a deep breath...

He slowly stood up.

"No more running."

"I have to tell him the truth."

Gathering every ounce of courage...

He walked toward the living room.

His father was sitting there peacefully.

Yashwanth stepped forward.

"Dad..."

"I want to tell you something..."

Just then...

Ding... Dong...

The doorbell rang.

His father smiled.

"Wait a minute."

"I'll be back."

He walked toward the entrance and opened the door.

Standing outside...

With his familiar gentle smile...

Was Siddhartha.

For a brief moment...

Yashwanth's father couldn't believe his eyes.

"Siddhartha!"

"What a wonderful surprise!"

He warmly shook Siddu's hand.

"How are you, my boy?"

"It's been such a long time."

"I keep seeing you in the news these days."

"I'm truly proud of everything you've achieved."

Siddu smiled respectfully.

"Thank you, Uncle."

"I'm doing well."

"But today..."

"I've come here to introduce someone to you."

Yashwanth's father looked at him curiously.

"Oh?"

"And who is that?"

Meanwhile...

The moment Yashwanth heard Siddu's voice...

Relief spread across his face.

"He came back..."

He quickly walked toward the entrance.

Just as he reached the doorway...

He noticed someone standing quietly beside Siddu.

Curious...

He lifted his eyes.

The very next second...

His footsteps came to an abrupt halt.

His eyes widened in disbelief.

Standing beside Siddu...

Was Varsha.

For a moment...

The world around him fell completely silent.

His heart skipped a beat.

"Varsha...?"

Fear instantly replaced the relief he had felt just moments earlier.

She wasn't merely standing before him...

She was standing before his father.

Yashwanth looked from Varsha...

To Siddu...

Unable to understand what was happening.

He had prepared himself to confess the truth...

But he had never imagined...

That Siddu would bring the truth itself...

To his doorstep.
